measured.note: zone-block volumes (overlaps not removed); the care-station box is the couch + two attendants' envelope, a measurement, not a shelter

open.item: Sustained local atmosphere at the care couch
must_specify: local free volume served (the sector, or a curtained care zone)
O2 supply rate and source for patient + 2 attendants
CO2 removal and trace-contaminant control rate
ventilation flow at the couch and air change rate
smoke / contaminant isolation from the rest of the sector
pressure hold time if the sector leaks; isolation valves; who closes the sector hatch
medical gas (O2 / suction) outlets at the couch
power and thermal load of the care kit
duration the care must be sustained (stabilisation vs definitive care)
which casualties shelter in place and which go to the storm refuge
time from SPE warning to sheltered
access path and its width with the couch deployed (measured here)
shelter boundary around the couch (the sector, or a local box)
how a non-movable casualty and the attendants are covered
communications and monitoring inside the shelter

open.item: SPE protection of the in-sector care station
must_specify: the 20 g/cm2 water-equivalent target is STUDY ONLY
water placement round each ring (80 t distribution not credited)
local shelter mass (4.1 t not credited)
areal density actually achieved (25.1 g/cm2 not credited)
GCR protection: NOT implied

open.item: Mass, shield and closure budget of the swap
must_specify: couch mass and mounting loads
displaced Garden_Rack_1 / Mess function: where the growing and common space go
any local closure or curtain
hinge, legs, latch, stowed depth (0.30 m is a PROTOTYPE stand-in)
patient restraint in 0 g, spin and 1.5 g
rating
what stabilisation is done at the couch and for how long
kit list (the 0.60 x 0.55 x 0.15 m box is the HUM-003 PROTOTYPE kit)
attendant count and skills
lost-ring dynamics: residual momentum, uncommanded spin-down, attitude (not represented)
in-sector casualty handling under 1.5 g (lowering onto the burn couch: hoist/handling concept and line loads)
one-ring stop stays uncredited; both-ring stop is the working constraint
